content:
Sorting ভুল হলে ব্যবহারকারী দেখতে পান "Price: Low to High" কিন্তু তালিকার শেষে সস্তা পণ্য এবং শুরুতে দামি। এটি UX-এর মারাত্মক ক্ষতি করে — এবং অনেক QA-এর চোখ এড়িয়ে যায়।

---

Basic Sorting Tests

TC-SORT-001: Sort by price ascending
Method: GET /api/products?sort=price&order=asc
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - First item has lowest price, last item has highest price
  - Verify: result[0].price <= result[1].price <= result[N].price

TC-SORT-002: Sort by price descending
Query: sort=price&order=desc
Expected: result[0].price >= result[1].price >= result[N].price

TC-SORT-003: Sort by name A-Z
Query: sort=name&order=asc
Expected: Alphabetical order (case-insensitive check)

TC-SORT-004: Sort by date (newest first)
Query: sort=createdAt&order=desc
Expected: Most recent records first
---

Edge Case Tests

TC-SORT-005: Sort with NULL/empty values
Dataset has some products with null price
Expected: Null values sorted consistently (e.g., always last or first — documented behavior)

TC-SORT-006: Invalid sort field
Query: sort=nonExistentField&order=asc
Expected: 400 Bad Request, "Invalid sort field." (NOT server error or random ordering)

TC-SORT-007: Invalid order direction
Query: sort=price&order=sideways
Expected: 400, "Sort order must be 'asc' or 'desc'."

TC-SORT-008: Sort without specifying order
Query: sort=price (no order param)
Expected: Default order applied (e.g., asc), documented in API spec
---

Combined Tests

TC-SORT-009: Sort + Filter combined
Query: category=electronics&sort=price&order=asc
Expected: Only electronics, sorted by price ascending

TC-SORT-010: Sort + Pagination consistency
Steps:
  1. GET /api/products?sort=price&order=asc&page=1&pageSize=10 → save results
  2. GET /api/products?sort=price&order=asc&page=2&pageSize=10 → save results
Expected:
  - Page 1 highest price <= Page 2 lowest price (no overlap or misordering)

TC-SORT-011: Multi-column sort
Query: sort=category,price&order=asc,desc
Expected: First sorted by category A-Z, then within same category by price desc
---

Data Integrity Check

TC-SORT-012: Total record count same regardless of sort
Compare: sort=price&order=asc total vs sort=name&order=desc total
Expected: "total" field identical — sorting doesn't lose or gain records
---

পরিশেষে

Sort + Pagination consistency হলো সবচেয়ে বেশি মিস হওয়া টেস্ট। Page 2-তে গেলে sort order ঠিক থাকে কিনা — এটি না দেখলে ব্যবহারকারী ভুল ক্রমে ডেটা দেখবেন।

Tags: #SortingTesting #APITesting #DataIntegrity #Pagination #QA #SQA
